Hamel Associates Has Boosted Its Consolidated Edison (ED) Stake; Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors Cut Its Apple (AAPL) Position by $639,443 as Stock Value Rose
June 11, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Hamel Associates Inc increased its stake in Consolidated Edison Inc (ED) by 16.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hamel Associates Inc bought 6,423 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.36% with the market. The institutional investor held 45,679 shares of the power generation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.56 million, up from 39,256 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hamel Associates Inc who had been investing in Consolidated Edison Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.45B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.67% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $72.26. About 382,896 shares traded. Consolidated Edison, Inc. (NYSE:ED) has declined 7.47% since June 11, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.04% the S&P500.
